# qutebrowser

qutebrowser, a keyboard-driven browser, in palette colors.

`config.py` keeps qutebrowser's defaults and adds only the palette (`colors.py`) and the desktop fonts; settings changed in the UI are not kept (autoconfig off). Pages prefer dark or light by the palette's variant. `theme set` re-sources the config in a running browser. Bookmarks, quickmarks and greasemonkey scripts stay local data.

## Reference

<!-- generated by tools/docs: reference -->
**Packages** (`qutebrowser/packages`): `qutebrowser`

**Linked into your home** (stow, `install.sh --link`):

- `~/.config/qutebrowser/colors.py`
- `~/.config/qutebrowser/config.py`

**Rendered from the palette** (`theme`):

- `qutebrowser/.config/qutebrowser/colors.py.tmpl` → `qutebrowser/.config/qutebrowser/colors.py`: `accent`, `badge`, `bg_desktop`, `bg_surface`, `bg_widget`, `border_hairline`, `error`, `fg_bright`, `fg_disabled`, `fg_secondary`, `fg_text`, `link`, `name`, `selection_bg`, `selection_fg`, `success`, `variant`, `warning`

**`reload.sh`** (run by `theme set`): re-read config.py (and colors.py) in a running qutebrowser. Only when one runs: the command line would otherwise start a new browser.
